title: Broad exception caught at 4 sites (L385,L394,L422,L488)
detail: Best-effort handlers log and continue without re-raising. While intentional, broad `except Exception` obscures unexpected failures. Suggested fix: narrow the exception type or add a sentinel for truly unexpected cases.

title: Star-arg unpacking after keyword argument at L176 (B026 — runtime SyntaxError risk)
detail: At L176, `manager_class(host=self.host, *args, **kwargs)` passes positional `*args` after a keyword argument. In Python 3, this is a `SyntaxError`. If `args` is ever non-empty this call will fail immediately. Suggested fix: reorder to `manager_class(*args, host=self.host, **kwargs)`.
